scenes.caption: Mohenjo-daro.
scenes.say: Rida walks through the ruins of Mohenjo-daro in Sindh.

scenes.caption: A grid.
scenes.say: The streets are straight and cross at right angles.

scenes.caption: Drains.
scenes.say: She sees covered drains beside the houses.

scenes.caption: Bricks.
scenes.say: The baked bricks are all the same size.

scenes.caption: A seal.
scenes.say: Under the sand, she finds a small seal with an animal.

scenes.caption: Signs.
scenes.say: Above the animal are signs that nobody can read yet.

scenes.caption: A mystery.
scenes.say: Why did the cities end? Experts keep asking.

scenes.caption: Heritage.
scenes.say: Rida promises to help protect Pakistan's heritage.
